rows.text: P&G maintained its fiscal 2027 diluted net earnings per share growth to be in the range of one to five percent versus fiscal 2026 diluted net EPS of $6.62.
P&G also maintained its fiscal 2027 core earnings per share growth to be in the range of in-line to three percent versus fiscal 2026 core EPS of $6.89.
P&G expects fiscal year 2027 diluted net earnings per share growth in the range of one to five percent versus fiscal 2026 GAAP EPS of $6.62.
P&G expects its fiscal 2027 core earnings per share growth in the range of in-line to three percent versus fiscal 2026 core EPS of $6.89.
